title: Career Roadmap: Mutual Fund Distributor
summary: Career Domain: Business, Finance & Entrepreneurship · Qualification Pathway: B.Com – B.Com - Investment / Wealth Management · Target Career: Mutual Fund Distributor

about.label: About this roadmap
about.text: This roadmap was drafted with AI assistance from OneGrasp's related roadmaps and is awaiting expert review. Check fees, dates, eligibility and exam patterns on the official websites before you rely on them.

about.label: Important
about.text: A distributor may not charge fees for advice; paid advice needs SEBI RIA registration.

blocks.text: A Mutual Fund Distributor helps investors choose and invest in mutual fund schemes, and earns commission from the fund houses. You need the NISM Series V-A certificate and an ARN registration with AMFI.
What a Mutual Fund Distributor does

items.text: Explain mutual fund types, risks and costs to investors
Help investors start SIPs and lump-sum investments
Learn how mutual funds, SIPs and NAV work
Start your own small SIP and track it
Apply for an ARN with AMFI
Learn KYC and online distribution platforms
Start advising family and friends under your ARN
Intern or work part-time with a distributor
MF Utility / BSE StAR MF / NSE NMF
NISM Series V-B (for a limited distributor role)

blocks.label: Before you enrol
blocks.text: Check the current syllabus, fees and eligibility on the certifying body's official website.
